title: Hold a licence to manufacture or supply medicines and poisons
what: Manufacture or supply Schedule 2, 3, 4 or 8 poisons (most medicines) only under an appropriate licence (such as a wholesale licence) or a professional authority.

sources.title: Medicines and Poisons Act 2014 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person who manufactures or supplies a Schedule 2 or 3 poison commits an offence unless — (a) the person does so — (i) under and in accordance with an appropriate licence or a professional authority

sources.title: Medicines and Poisons Act 2014 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person who manufactures or supplies a Schedule 4 or 8 poison commits an offence unless subsection (1A) is complied with
